page.layout: One printed page (left) of running text at top, a dated imprint and printer's name centred below, a woodcut ornament in the middle, signature mark at lower right; a narrow strip of marginal notes at the right edge belongs to the adjacent page and is not transcribed as notes of this page.

main_text.p: quod attinet, omnia à capite ad calcem recognovi, hinc inde nonnulla addidi vel suftuli, inprimis autem locorum N. T. citatione vocum explicationem passim illustrare studui. Vale & hunc Christianam juventutem juvandi conatum æqui boniqueconsule.
Groninga& Eid.Sept. M. D C. X X X I X.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (a winged cherub with a halo above a foliate scroll) is not transcribed. The right edge shows part of the facing page with Greek marginal notes, which are not part of this page. Some words are slightly blurred by show-through from the reverse; the line "boniqueconsule" is printed with the space missing as shown.
